name: passenger-test-node-packages
description: The project's own ESLint and Prettier (and Prettier 2, as prettier2), Oxlint, Oxfmt and Biome the tests put in a test folder's node_modules (EslintPrettierTests), Yarn, which lays out a test's Plug'n'Play project with no registry, and xterm.js run without a screen, which TerminalEmulationTests holds the terminal to, fetched at build by tools/Passenger.NodePackages; never carried by the app.
